purpose: Single source for the directory and extension sets that repository scanners must skip. Exists because five scanners in this workspace each hand-wrote their own EXCLUDED_DIRS list (cynic-release secret_lint, cynic-host local_disk x2, cynic-host space_gc/observe, cynic-host-probes llm), and they had drifted: node_modules appears in all five, .cargo-home and vendor in one, and no Python cache in any of them. A Python venv in the tree therefore reached `cynic audit secret` and failed the release gate on a third-party `verify_token=` literal. Declaring the sets here makes the drift observable instead of discovered at gate time.
notes: This registry declares what scanners skip. It does NOT declare what the filesystem must contain; infra/directory-tree.json owns that. Adding a required path here would be a category error.
A scanner that cannot read this file MUST keep a compiled-in fallback identical to the `fallback` lists below, so a missing registry degrades to today's behaviour instead of scanning everything.

secret_lint.purpose: Detect credential-shaped literals in tracked source before release.
secret_lint.measured_gap_closed: 1.3G .venv_data tree, 25854 files walked, one false-positive finding at huggingface_hub/_eval_results.py:67

disk_scan.purpose: Enumerate disk usage on a host. Must not descend into dependency trees to count build output as user data.
disk_scan.measured_gap_closed: the two local_disk walkers excluded only .git and node_modules, so a Python venv counted as host data

space_gc.purpose: Report reclaimable space for garbage collection.
space_gc.measured_gap_closed: GC candidates were computed over dependency caches, which are regenerable and must never be reported as reclaimable user space

fallback.why: A scanner may run outside the repository root (packaged release, builder sandbox) where infra/ is absent. Compiling the list in keeps the gate fail-closed on a real finding rather than fail-open by scanning a vendored venv.
